title: Artificial Analysis
summary: Artificial Analysis measurements from the 12 Oct 2026 Muse Wonder article. These are separate from Meta's developer table, including where both mention Terminal-Bench.
howItCompiles: Intelligence Index v4.3 combines ten evaluations AA runs.
The article gives Spark 1.3, Wonder, and Wonder Full at max effort.
Coding Agents Index scores are for the named agent product: Muse Code for Muse models.

limits: Wonder Full has no token price, so AA does not publish a cost per task for it.
AA's Terminal-Bench percent for Wonder Full is 57, which the article calls level with Gemini 4 Argon high on AA's run. That is not Anthropic's 66.4%.
